news.title: Inside AMEX’s agentic commerce stack: How intent contracts and single-use tokens enforce AI transactions
news.summary_raw: American Express (Amex) is building a system that lets AI agents shop and pay on behalf of users — but right now it’s only within its own payment network, and still involves a black box that could hinder trust and auditability. Amex already participates in agentic commerce protocol projects, especially Google’s Agent Pay Protocol (AP2), which focuses on interoperability. Amex’s Agentic Commerce Experiences (ACE) developer kit, on the other hand, touches on something most protocols currently lack
news.summary: American Express is developing an agentic commerce system that allows AI agents to shop and pay on behalf of users within its own payment network, using intent contracts and single-use tokens. The system currently lacks transparency, hindering trust and auditability.
news.enterprise_use: The system is intended for enterprise use in the AI and commerce industries, with potential applications including automated bill payment and AI-powered customer service.
